# Parallel Trend Assumptions

## Parallel Trends

$$\mathbb{E}\big[ Y_{i1}(0) - Y_{i0}(0) \mid T_i = 1 \big] = \mathbb{E}\big[ Y_{i1}(0) - Y_{i0}(0) \mid T_i = 0 \big]$$

The average \textit{trend in untreated potential outcomes} is the same for treated and control groups.

## No Anticipation

$$Y_{i0}(1) = Y_{i0}(0) \quad \text{for all } i$$

Treatment has no causal effect prior to implementation.


# Simplest setting - 2x2
```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
library(tidyverse)
library(fixest)
library(panelView)
library(did)
library(HonestDiD)
library(PanelMatch)
library(haven)
# library(janitor)
# library(DIDmultiplegt)
library(bacondecomp)
library(TwoWayFEWeights)
library(knitr)
library(modelsummary)
library(kableExtra)

theme_set(theme_minimal(base_size = 20))
set.seed(1234)
```

```{r}
#| label: sim-2x2-data
#| echo: false
n_treated <- 1000
n_control <- 1000

sim_2x2 <- tibble(
  id = 1:(n_treated + n_control),
  group = rep(c("control", "treated"), c(n_control, n_treated))
) |>
  tidyr::expand_grid(period = c("pre", "post")) |>
  mutate(
    treated_group = as.integer(group == "treated"),
    post = as.integer(period == "post"),
    D = treated_group * post,
    alpha_i = if_else(group == "treated", 2, 1),
    lambda_t = if_else(period == "post", 1, 0),
    tau = 2,
    y0 = alpha_i + lambda_t + rnorm(n(), 0, 1),
    Y = y0 + tau * D
  )
```


```{r}
#| label: plot-2x2-means
#| echo: false
#| fig-width: 6
#| fig-height: 3
sim_2x2 |>
  mutate(
    period = factor(period, levels = c("pre", "post")),
    group  = factor(group, levels = c("control", "treated"))
  ) |>
  group_by(group, period) |>
  summarise(mean_y = mean(Y), .groups = "drop") |>
  ggplot(aes(x = period, y = mean_y, group = group, color = group)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +                # slightly smaller points
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +            # slightly thinner line
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "control" = "#0072B2",
      "treated" = "#D55E00"
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "2x2 DID: mean outcomes by group and period",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Mean outcome",
    color = "group"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)
```


# 2x2 DID Estimate
\scriptsize
```{r}
#| label: did-by-hand-and-feols
# By hand
sim_2x2 |>
  group_by(group, period) |>
  summarise(mean_y = mean(Y), .groups = "drop") |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = c(group, period), values_from = mean_y) |>
  mutate(did = (treated_post - treated_pre) - (control_post - control_pre))
```

\pause 
```{r}
# TWFE regression
fit_twfe <- feols(Y ~ D | id + period, data = sim_2x2)
# interaction regression 
fit_interaction <- feols(Y ~ treated_group * post, data = sim_2x2)
# First difference
sim_diff <- sim_2x2 |>
  select(id, treated_group, period, Y) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = period, values_from = Y) |>
  mutate(
    dY = post - pre,
    treated_fd = treated_group)
fit_fd <- feols(dY ~ treated_fd, data = sim_diff)
```

# 2x2 DID

```{r}
#| echo: false
models <- list(
  "TWFE" = fit_twfe,
  "Interaction" = fit_interaction,
  "First difference" = fit_fd
)

coef_map <- c(
  "D" = "DID effect",
  "treated_group:post" = "DID effect",
  "treated_group" = "DID effect"
)

modelsummary(
  models,
  coef_map = c(
    "D" = "DID effect",
    "treated_group:post" = "DID effect",
    "treated_fd" = "DID effect"
  ),
  statistic = "std.error",
  stars = c("***" = 0.01, "**" = 0.05, "*" = 0.1),
  gof_map = "nobs",
  output = "kableExtra"
) |>
  add_header_above(c(" " = 1, "Equivalent DID estimators" = 3))
```

# Multi-period single-event DID

- Multiple pre-treatment periods and/or multiple post-treatment periods
- All treated units receive treatment at the same time \pause
- We can study **Dynamic ATT** now: 
$$\tau_k = \mathbb{E}\big[ Y_{i,k}(1) - Y_{i,k}(0) \mid T_i = 1 \big], 
\quad k = 1, \dots, K.$$
\pause

- Pre-trends and sensitivity analysis

# `PanelView` treatment status
\scriptsize
```{r}
#| label: sim-single-event
#| echo: false
n_treated <- 200
n_control <- 200
periods <- 1:8
adopt_period <- 5

single_event <- tibble(
  id = 1:(n_treated + n_control),
  treated = rep(c(0, 1), c(n_control, n_treated)),
  unit_fe = rnorm(n_treated + n_control, 0, 1),
  group_trend = rep(c(0.15, 0.15), c(n_control, n_treated))
) |>
  tidyr::expand_grid(period = periods) |>
  mutate(
    time_fe = 0.4 * period,
    D = as.integer(treated == 1 & period >= adopt_period),
    time_to_treat = period - adopt_period,
    tau = case_when(
      D == 0 ~ 0,
      time_to_treat == 0 ~ 0.8,
      time_to_treat == 1 ~ 1.5,
      time_to_treat == 2 ~ 2.0,
      time_to_treat >= 3 ~ 2.4,
      TRUE ~ 0
    ),
    y0 = unit_fe + time_fe + group_trend * period + rnorm(n(), 0, 1),
    Y = y0 + tau
  )
```


```{r}
#| label: panelview-single-event
#| fig-width: 6
#| fig-height: 3
panelview(
  Y = "Y", D = "D", data = single_event,
  index = c("id", "period"),  by.timing = TRUE, display.all = TRUE
)

```

# `PanelView` outcome
\scriptsize

```{r}
#| label: panelview-single-event-outcome
#| fig-width: 6
#| fig-height: 3
panelview(
  Y = "Y", D = "D", data = single_event, type = "outcome",
  index = c("id", "period"), by.timing = TRUE, display.all = TRUE
)
```

# Pooled TWFE
\scriptsize
```{r}
pooled_twfe <- feols(Y ~ D | id + period, data = single_event, 
                     cluster = ~id)
etable(pooled_twfe)
```
\normalsize

- Fine in a single-event setting if we have homogeneous effects 
- If effects change overtime, pooled TWFE is a weighted average of those effects

# Event study specification 
Period-specific effects relative to a omitted reference period
$$Y_{it} = \alpha_i + \lambda_t + \sum_{\substack{k=-J \\ k \ne \text{ref}}}^{K} \delta_k \cdot T_i \times \mathbf{1}(t = k) + \epsilon_{it}$$

- $\delta_k$ for $k > 0$: dynamic treatment effects (relative to ref. period).
- $\delta_k$ for $k < 0$: pre-treatment lead coefficients
- pre-trends or anticipation \pause
- Common choice for reference period
    - last pre-treatment period
    - period before the last pre-treatment period \pause
    - Shifts what the post-treatment coefficients measure



# TWFE event study 
\tiny
```{r}
#| label: twfe-event-study-single-event
#| fig-width: 6
#| fig-height: 3
es_twfe <- feols(
  Y ~ i(time_to_treat, treated, ref = -1) | id + period,
  data = single_event, cluster = ~id)
summary(es_twfe)
```
\pause

```{r}
coef_es <- coef(es_twfe)
post_coefs <- coef_es[grepl("time_to_treat::[0-9]+:treated", names(coef_es))]
mean(post_coefs)
```


# TWFE event study 
\scriptsize
```{r}
#| label: twfe-event-study-single-event-plot
#| fig-width: 6
#| fig-height: 3
iplot(es_twfe, main = "")
```

\normalsize
\pause

- Under parallel trends and no anticipation, pre-treatment lead coefficients should be close to zero \pause
- But a flat pre-trend is not proof

# TWFE event study - no anticipation

\scriptsize
```{r}
#| label: twfe-event-study-single-event-anticipation
#| fig-width: 6
#| fig-height: 3
es_twfe_ref2 <- feols(
  Y ~ i(time_to_treat, treated, ref = -2) | id + period, 
  data = single_event, cluster = ~id
)
iplot(es_twfe_ref2, main = "")
```

# Pre-trend
```{r}
#| echo: FALSE
#| fig-width: 6
#| fig-height: 3

set.seed(123)

n_treated <- 200
n_control <- 200
periods <- -4:3
adopt_period <- 0

single_event_pretrend_violation <- tibble(
  id = 1:(n_treated + n_control),
  treated = rep(c(0, 1), c(n_control, n_treated)),
  unit_fe = rnorm(n_treated + n_control, 0, 1),
  group_trend = if_else(
    rep(c(0, 1), c(n_control, n_treated)) == 1,
    0.45,   # treated units have steeper underlying trend
    0.10    # control units have flatter underlying trend
  )
) |>
  tidyr::expand_grid(period = periods) |>
  mutate(
    time_fe = 0.4 * period,
    time_to_treat = period - adopt_period,
    D = as.integer(treated == 1 & period >= adopt_period),
    tau = case_when(
      D == 0 ~ 0,
      time_to_treat == 0 ~ 0.8,
      time_to_treat == 1 ~ 1.5,
      time_to_treat == 2 ~ 2.0,
      time_to_treat >= 3 ~ 2.4,
      TRUE ~ 0
    ),
    y0 = unit_fe + time_fe + group_trend * period + rnorm(n(), 0, 1),
    Y = y0 + tau
  )

es_twfe_pretrend <- feols(
  Y ~ i(time_to_treat, treated, ref = -1) | id + period,
  data = single_event_pretrend_violation,
  cluster = ~id
)

iplot(
  es_twfe_pretrend,
  xlab = "time_to_treat",
  ylab = "Estimate and 95% Conf. Int."
)
```


# `HonestDiD`

If post-treatment trend violations were no larger than some multiple of the pre-treatment pattern, would the treatment effect still be statistically distinguishable from zero? \pause

- Estimate an event study
- Use the pre-treatment coefficients to inform possible violations after the treatment
- A sensitivity parameter $\bar M$
- Check how the confidence set changes as $\bar M$ increases

# `HonestDiD` - Single Event
\scriptsize
```{r}
betahat <- summary(es_twfe)$coefficients
sigma <- summary(es_twfe)$cov.scaled
delta_rm_results <- HonestDiD::createSensitivityResults_relativeMagnitudes(
  betahat = betahat, #coefficients 
  sigma = sigma, #covariance matrix 
  numPrePeriods = 3, #num. of pre-treatment coefs 
  numPostPeriods = 4, #num. of post-treatment coefs 
  Mbarvec = seq(1,2,by=0.25) #values of Mbar
)
delta_rm_results
```

# `HonestDiD` - Single Event
\scriptsize
```{r}
#| fig-width: 6
#| fig-height: 2
originalResults <- HonestDiD::constructOriginalCS(
  betahat = betahat, sigma = sigma, 
  numPrePeriods = 3, numPostPeriods = 4)
HonestDiD::createSensitivityPlot_relativeMagnitudes(delta_rm_results, originalResults) + theme_minimal(base_size = 10)
```

# `HonestDiD` - Single Event Example 2
\tiny
```{r}
#| fig-width: 6
#| fig-height: 2
betahat_pt <- summary(es_twfe_pretrend)$coefficients
sigma_pt <- summary(es_twfe_pretrend)$cov.scaled

delta_rm_results <- HonestDiD::createSensitivityResults_relativeMagnitudes(
  betahat = betahat_pt, #coefficients 
  sigma = sigma_pt, #covariance matrix 
  numPrePeriods = 3, #num. of pre-treatment coefs 
  numPostPeriods = 4, #num. of post-treatment coefs 
  Mbarvec = seq(1,2,by=0.25) #values of Mbar )
)
originalResults <- HonestDiD::constructOriginalCS(
  betahat = betahat_pt, sigma = sigma_pt, 
  numPrePeriods = 3, numPostPeriods = 4)
HonestDiD::createSensitivityPlot_relativeMagnitudes(delta_rm_results, originalResults) + theme_minimal(base_size = 10)
```


# Staggered Adoption - common in applied works

- Different units adopt in different periods 
- Dynamic treatment effects are allowed \pause 

Under staggered adoption, the TWFE coefficient is a weighted average of many 2x2 comparisons.

## Some are clean:

- newly treated versus never treated
- earlier treated versus later treated while the later cohort is still untreated

## Some are bad:

- later treated units compared to already treated units

# Simulated Example `PanelView`
\scriptsize
```{r}
#| echo: false
set.seed(123)

n_per_cohort <- 100
periods <- 1:10
cohorts <- c(2, 4, 6, 8, Inf)

sim_staggered <- tibble(
  id = 1:(n_per_cohort * length(cohorts)),
  g = rep(cohorts, each = n_per_cohort)
) |>
  expand_grid(period = periods) |>
  mutate(
    treated = if_else(!is.infinite(g) & period >= g, 1, 0),
    time_to_treat = if_else(is.infinite(g), NA_real_, period - g),
    g_cs = if_else(is.infinite(g), 0, g),       # for Callaway-Sant'Anna
    g_sa = if_else(is.infinite(g), 1000, g)     # for Sun-Abraham/fixest
  )

unit_fe <- tibble(
  id = unique(sim_staggered$id),
  alpha_i = rnorm(n_distinct(sim_staggered$id), 0, 1)
)

time_fe <- tibble(
  period = periods,
  lambda_t = c(-0.5, -0.2, 0, 0.2, 0.4, 0.5, 0.7, 0.8, 1.0, 1.1)
)

sim_staggered <- sim_staggered |>
  left_join(unit_fe, by = "id") |>
  left_join(time_fe, by = "period") |>
  mutate(
    y0 = alpha_i + lambda_t + rnorm(n(), 0, 0.8),
    tau = case_when(
      treated == 0 ~ 0,

      g == 2 & time_to_treat == 0 ~ 0.2,
      g == 2 & time_to_treat == 1 ~ 0.6,
      g == 2 & time_to_treat >= 2 ~ 1.0,

      g == 4 & time_to_treat == 0 ~ 0.5,
      g == 4 & time_to_treat == 1 ~ 1.0,
      g == 4 & time_to_treat >= 2 ~ 1.5,

      g == 6 & time_to_treat == 0 ~ 1.0,
      g == 6 & time_to_treat == 1 ~ 1.8,
      g == 6 & time_to_treat >= 2 ~ 2.5,

      g == 8 & time_to_treat == 0 ~ 1.8,
      g == 8 & time_to_treat == 1 ~ 2.8,
      g == 8 & time_to_treat >= 2 ~ 3.5,

      TRUE ~ 0
    ),
    y = y0 + tau
  )
```

```{r}
#| fig-width: 6
#| fig-height: 3
panelview(
  Y = "y", D = "treated", data = sim_staggered,
  index = c("id", "period"),  by.timing = TRUE, display.all = TRUE)
```

# dCDH `TwoWayFEWeights`
\scriptsize
```{r}
library(TwoWayFEWeights)
twfe_wts <- twowayfeweights(data = sim_staggered, Y = "y", G = "id",
                            T = "period", D = "treated", type = "feTR", summary_measures = TRUE)
twfe_wts
```

```{r}
#| eval: false
#| include: false
str(twfe_wts)
names(twfe_wts)

weight_df <- twfe_wts[[which(sapply(twfe_wts, is.data.frame))[1]]]
weight_plot_df <- sim_staggered |>
  distinct(id, g, period, treated, time_to_treat, tau) |>
  left_join(
    weight_df |>
      rename(id = G, period = `T`, weight = weight),
    by = c("id", "period")
  )

weight_plot_df |>
  filter(treated == 1, is.finite(g)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = time_to_treat, y = weight, color = factor(g))) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = 2) +
  labs(
    title = "TWFE weights on treated group-time cells",
    x = "Event time",
    y = "Weight",
    color = "Cohort"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)

weight_plot_df |>
  filter(treated == 1) |>
  summarise(
    weighted_tau = sum(weight * tau, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
coef(twfe_fit)[["treated"]]
```

# Callaway \& Sant'Anna
- Default control group is "nevertreated", can be set to "notyettreated"
- default estimation method is doubly robust from `DRDID`
\scriptsize
```{r}
library(did)
cs_dr <- att_gt(yname = "y",      # outcome variable
                gname = "g",      # group variable
                idname = "id",    # unit identifier
                tname = "period", # year variable
                xformla = ~1,     # covariates (if any)
                data = sim_staggered,  
                est_method = "dr",     
                control_group = "nevertreated"
)
```

# Callaway \& Sant'Anna
Aggregated overall ATT:
\scriptsize
```{r}
aggte(cs_dr, type ="simple", na.rm=T)
```

# Callaway \& Sant'Anna
Dynamic ATT (Event-Study):
\scriptsize
```{r}
#| fig-width: 6
#| fig-height: 3
cs_dynamic <- aggte(cs_dr, type = "dynamic")
ggdid(cs_dynamic)
```

# HonestDiD with staggered treatment
\scriptsize
```{r}
source(("honest-helpers.R"))
# Need to specify the "universal" type base period to use honestDiD
es_out <- att_gt(yname = "y", gname = "g", idname = "id",
               tname = "period", xformla = ~1, control_group = "nevertreated",
               data = sim_staggered, est_method = "reg",
               base_period = "universal")
es <- aggte(es_out, type = "dynamic")
sensitivity_results <- honest_did.AGGTEobj(
  es, e = 1, type = "relative_magnitude", Mbarvec = seq(0.5, 2, by = 0.5),
  grid.ub = 10, grid.lb = -10, gridPoints = 2000)
```

# Honest DiD
\scriptsize
```{r}
#| fig-width: 6
#| fig-height: 2
HonestDiD::createSensitivityPlot_relativeMagnitudes(sensitivity_results$robust_ci,
    sensitivity_results$orig_ci)+theme_minimal(base_size = 10)
```

# Example Study

Mafia and political quality: Daniele \& Geys (EJ 2015)

![](data/daniele_geys_abstract.png){fig-align="center" width=100%}


# Example Study

- What is the effect of removing mafia connections on the quality of politicians?
- Staggered dissolution of municipal governments in Italian south after criminal investigations
- Outcome: education of government members (average) \pause
- ``Unlike the traditional DiD model, which relies on a shock at one point in time across all treated jurisdictions, we can exploit the fact that dissolutions did not take place at the same point in time for each municipality [. . . ] to further strengthen our identification''


```{r}
#| label: load-mafia
#| echo: false

mafia_raw <- haven::read_dta("data/Organized Crime and Political Quality.dta")

mafia_df <- mafia_raw |>
  mutate(
    year = as.integer(year),
    ID_municip = as.integer(ID_municip),
    mafiaben = coalesce(as.numeric(mafiaben), 0),
    befcomgeneral = coalesce(as.numeric(befcomgeneral), 0),
    befcomgeneral_recode = (1 - befcomgeneral) * mafiaben
  )
```

# `panelView` treatment status
\scriptsize
```{r}
#| label: panelview-mafia-treatment
#| fig-width: 6
#| fig-height: 3
panelview(
  MeanEduPol ~ befcomgeneral_recode, data = mafia_df,
  index = c("ID_municip", "year"), xlab = "Year", ylab = "Municipality",
  display.all = TRUE, gridOff = TRUE, by.timing = TRUE)
```

# `panelView`: outcomes by treatment cohort
\scriptsize
```{r}
#| label: panelview-mafia-outcome
#| fig-width: 6
#| fig-height: 3
panelview(
  MeanEduPol ~ befcomgeneral_recode, data = mafia_df, index = c("ID_municip", "year"),
  by.timing = TRUE, display.all = FALSE, type = "outcome", by.cohort = TRUE)
```


# Pooled TWFE
\scriptsize
```{r}
#| label: mafia-twfe-lab
# each municipality have its own linear time trend.
mafia_twfe <- feols(
  MeanEduPol ~ befcomgeneral_recode | ID_municip[trend] + year, 
  data = mafia_df, cluster = ~ID_municip)
etable(mafia_twfe)
```


# Data Prep
Define treatment groups based on their first year of treatment
```{r}
mafia_df <- mafia_df %>% group_by(desc_comune) %>% 
  mutate(group = case_when(mafiaben==1 ~ min(year[befcomgeneral_recode==1]),
                           mafiaben==0 ~ 0)) %>%
  ungroup()
```

# Callaway \& Sant'Anna
\tiny
```{r}
library(did)
set.seed(1)
cs_dr <- att_gt(yname = "MeanEduPol",      # outcome variable
                gname = "group",           # group variable
                idname = "ID_municip",     # unit identifier
                tname = "year",            # year variable
                xformla = ~1,              # covariates (if any)
                data = mafia_df,           # data
                est_method = "dr",         # estimation method
                allow_unbalanced_panel = T, # allow unbalanced panel
                control_group = "nevertreated" # control group
)
tidy(cs_dr)
```

# TWFE Weights
\scriptsize
```{r}
#| label: mafia-twowayfeweights
#| eval: false
wgt_diag <- twowayfeweights(
  mafia_df, "MeanEduPol", "ID_municip", "year",
  "befcomgeneral_recode", type = "feTR", summary_measures = TRUE)
wgt_diag
```


# Create Staggered Variables
\scriptsize
```{r}
#| label: mafia-cohort-event-time
cohorts <- mafia_df |>
  group_by(ID_municip) |>
  summarise(
    first_treat = if (any(befcomgeneral_recode == 1)) 
      min(year[befcomgeneral_recode == 1]) else 0L,
    ever_treated = as.integer(first_treat > 0),
    .groups = "drop")

mafia_staggered <- mafia_df |>
  left_join(cohorts, by = "ID_municip") |>
  mutate(
    time_to_treat = if_else(ever_treated == 1, year - first_treat, 0L))
```

# Create Staggered Variables
\tiny
```{r}
#| label: mafia-cohort-event-time-display
mafia_staggered |>
  select(desc_comune, year, befcomgeneral_recode, first_treat, ever_treated, time_to_treat) |>
  arrange(desc_comune, year) |>
  filter(desc_comune == "ACERRA") |> 
  head(15)
```

# TWFE Event Study & Sun-Abraham with `fixest`
\scriptsize
```{r}
#| label: mafia-twfe-dynamic
twfe_es_fit <- feols(
  MeanEduPol ~ i(time_to_treat, ever_treated, ref = -1) | ID_municip + year,
  data = mafia_staggered, cluster = ~ID_municip)
mafia_sa <- mafia_staggered |>
  mutate(first_treat_sa = if_else(first_treat == 0, 10000L, first_treat))
sa_fit <- feols(
  MeanEduPol ~ sunab(first_treat_sa, year) | ID_municip + year,
  data = mafia_sa,
  cluster = ~ID_municip)
```


# TWFE Event Study & Sun-Abraham with `fixest` Plot
\tiny
```{r}
#| label: mafia-sunab
#| echo: false
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 4
iplot(list(twfe_es_fit, sa_fit)); legend("bottomright", col = c(1,2), pch = c(20, 17), legend = c("TWFE", "Sun & Abraham (2020)"))
```
